text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We're here, the ocean!
The huge, wide ocean!!

On our way back from going out, Twin Turbo suddenly
said, "Follow me!" and dragged me along, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whooosh! Crash!!
Look at that, Trainer!
It's the "ocean"!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I brought paper and a pen today too,
so I'll give some to you, Trainer!

“—I see. It seems you've come
to write calligraphy again.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Hey there. I wondered why it was so noisy, but
of course it was Turbo's voice."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature! Did you come to buy dried squid again?
The super tasty kind!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. More importantly, isn't it rare to see you here, Turbo?
You're not thinking of diving in from here and going for a swim, are you?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Turbo came to write
"Sea" with Trainer!
Oh, Nature, wanna write too?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Calligraphy... Ah, I see.
Looks fun, but I'll just watch.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Besides, it's not like I could write anything interesting anyway.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then Nature's the judge!!
Decide whose 'ocean' you like better,
Trainer's or Turbo's!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"It's on! Bring it on!
Here we gooo! Turbo's defiii-nitely gonna win!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha... With that momentum,
there's no stopping them now, huh.

Twin Turbo basically never holds back.
If she wants to do something, she says it, and if she doesn't, she won't.
She has an unpretentious personality, and you could call her simple, but it's not as if she never thinks about anything—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The sea is huge, so we need something huge too!!
Ka-boooom!!
...It shouldn't be.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... in both her heart and her handwriting,
Turbo is just completely honest and straightforward, isn't she?

True to her heart, hiding no emotion.
The honesty seeping from her writing naturally drew in the hearts of those who saw it.
choice_data_list: Precisely because you don't overthink it...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"That's what they call charm, I s'pose.
I sure couldn't pull that off."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The ocean! Ah, a jellyfish!
Wait, no, it's a plastic bag!!

Her innate sensitivity...
Perhaps that, too, is part of Twin Turbo's charm.

It was a side of Twin Turbo
that I felt I should have known,
yet had never noticed until now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So, what kind of "ocean" will Turbo's Trainer write?
At her suggestion, I gazed out at the sea for a moment—
choice_data_list: In calm handwriting, the character for 'sea'...

text_block_list.text: Filling the entire sheet of paper, she wrote "Ocean" with an almost overwhelming force.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! Is that your ocean, Trainer!?
It's a pretty good match for Turbo's ocean!!

I took the word "Sea" written by Twin Turbo
and showed both side-by-side to Nice Nature.
Both had impressive, powerful brushwork.
Nice Nature pondered for a moment—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All that momentum, and impossible to take your eyes off...
Truly fitting for Turbo's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! That's right!
Trainer is Turbo's trainer,
so Trainer is amazing just like Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright. In that case, this is...
a tie for both sides! ...I suppose?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
! A tie! Mmmgh, not bad, Trainer!
Turbo's gonna win next time, though,
so this time we can celebrate together!!

Next to Nice Nature who watched over them with a smile,
Twin Turbo and the Trainer threw their hands up together
in joyous celebration.

Inspired by the sound of waves and an image of steadfast composure,
I wrote a calm, serene 'Sea'.

I took the paper Twin Turbo handed me
and held it up next to mine.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oh, so that is Trainer's "sea"!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh…… Feels so mature.
Is it meant to evoke a calm ocean?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're the total opposite of Turbo. But since Turbo's, well, Turbo, you two actually make a pretty good pair~

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh!? What do you mean by that!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Still, I guess Turbo wins this time? That 'ocean' looks ready to burst off the page—it's so dynamic and eye-catching.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo won!? Yay--!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Still, your "ocean" was awesome too, Trainer!
It's calming, just like you!
Turbo totally loved it!
Although I lost the contest, seeing Twin Turbo so happy with the "Ocean" calligraphy I had written washed away any lingering frustration.

Jellyfish—
It turned out to be just a floating plastic bag, but I decided to write while picturing one anyway.

I took the paper Twin Turbo handed me
and held it up next to mine.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-aah! A jellyfish! It's like a jellyfish!
It's all squishy-squashy! Amazing, so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo really loves this "sea"!
Trainer, you're amazing! Nice one!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so you can write it like that too.
Turbo's super intense "Ocean" is nice, but...
maybe Trainer takes the win this time?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I lost!!
So frustrating, so frustrating!!
choice_data_list: Thanks to Master Twin Turbo's teachings

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Master?! It's all thanks to Turbo?!
Really?! Since when?!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... I see!
So it was all thanks to Turbo!
Alright, time to train even harder from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna visit tons of places
and write tons of things!!
Trainer, keep up with meee!!
